text: I think the hardest part is motivation. People often say they're too busy, but really they find it difficult to change their daily routine. Another reason is that some people feel embarrassed in the gym, especially if they're out of shape. What usually helps is starting small, like a ten-minute walk, and finding a friend to exercise with, because you don't want to let them down.

tips.en: Contrast shows two sides of the issue, which works well in Part 3.
tips.kk: Қарама-қайшылық сұрақтың екі жағын көрсетеді — Part 3 үшін күшті тәсіл.
tips.ru: Противопоставление показывает две стороны вопроса — это сильный ход для Part 3.
tips.example: People often say they're too busy, but really they find it difficult to change their daily routine

tips.en: Precise topic vocabulary lifts the Lexical Resource score.
tips.kk: Тақырыпқа сай нақты лексика Lexical Resource бағасын көтереді.
tips.ru: Точная лексика по теме повышает оценку Lexical Resource.
tips.example: especially if they're out of shape

questions.question: Why do some people find it hard to start exercising?

text: Yes, I'd say so, because children spend most of the day sitting down, and regular exercise is essential for their development. Having said that, PE shouldn't be only about competition. Children who dislike team sports might prefer yoga, dancing or swimming, so schools ought to offer a variety. If the lessons are enjoyable, kids are more likely to stay active as adults.

tips.en: 'Having said that' softens the position and shows a balanced view.
tips.kk: «Having said that» ұстанымды жұмсартып, салмақты көзқарасты көрсетеді.
tips.ru: «Having said that» смягчает позицию и показывает взвешенный взгляд.
tips.example: Having said that, PE shouldn't be only about competition

tips.en: A conditional with a comparison raises Grammatical Range.
tips.kk: Салыстыруы бар шартты сөйлем Grammatical Range-ді арттырады.
tips.ru: Условное предложение со сравнением повышает Grammatical Range.
tips.example: If the lessons are enjoyable, kids are more likely to stay active as adults

questions.followUp: What about children who dislike sports?
questions.question: Should schools make physical education compulsory?

text: Mainly because sport is a huge business now. Millions of people watch matches, so clubs earn a fortune from tickets, TV rights and advertising, and a part of that goes to the players. It also takes years of sacrifice to reach that level, and a career is short. But I do think it's a bit unfair compared with nurses or teachers, who contribute so much to society.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.
tips.kk: Себеп пен салдар пайымдауды логикалы етеді.
tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: so clubs earn a fortune from tickets, TV rights and advertising

tips.en: Comparing professions shows a balanced view.
tips.example: But I do think it's a bit unfair compared with nurses or teachers

note.en: to make a lot of money

questions.question: Why do professional athletes earn so much money?

text: It's hard to say. On one hand, we have better medicine, fitness trackers and more information about nutrition, so people could live longer and healthier lives. On the other hand, many jobs involve sitting at a desk all day, and processed food is everywhere. I suspect there'll be a growing gap between people who take care of themselves and those who don't.

tips.en: Hedging sounds natural and shows you are weighing the opinion.
tips.kk: Сақ тұжырым табиғи естіледі және пікірді саралап жатқаныңызды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Осторожная формулировка звучит естественно и показывает, что вы взвешиваете мнение.

tips.en: Contrast shows two sides of the issue, which works well in Part 3.

tips.ru: Противопоставление показывает две стороны вопроса — это сильный ход для Part 3.
